Metadata.title: PlatePilot — Your restaurant, from first order to close
Metadata.description: Ordering, payments, reservations, kitchen service and a live dining-room view in one calm restaurant operating system.

Footer.tagline: Your restaurant, from first order to close.

Home.title: Service has enough moving parts.
Home.description: PlatePilot brings ordering, payments, tables and the kitchen into one clear rhythm—so your team can focus on the people in front of them.
Home.note: Start with your real data. No demo restaurant required.
Home.previewTitle: A room your team can read.
Home.previewDescription: Build the view from your own floor plan. Every table stays connected to service, reservations and the POS.
Home.previewEmptyBody: Add real dimensions, tables and zones. Nothing is pre-filled.
Home.productDescription: Each handoff stays visible, accountable and connected to the same order—without making your team learn a dozen different tools.
Home.orderingBody: Pickup, delivery, dine-in QR and scheduled orders, priced from your published menu and service rules.
Home.paymentsBody: Hosted checkout, authentic webhooks, independent verification and reconciliation that separates payment from fulfillment.
Home.floorTitle: A floor plan that does work
Home.floorBody: Plan in accessible 2D, then opt into 3D. The same table drives reservations, QR sessions and open checks.
Home.kitchenTitle: A kitchen always in the loop
Home.kitchenBody: Route items by station, track preparation and create one ticket—even when a provider sends the same event twice.
Home.floorSectionTitle: See the room. Know the next move.
Home.floorSectionBody: Available, reserved, seated or resetting: table state is clear at a glance and always available as text. The 3D view loads only when asked, and every workflow remains usable in 2D.
Home.floorPointTwo: Real dimensions in metres, not a stock room
Home.floorPointThree: Automatic fallback when WebGL is unavailable
Home.globalBody: Keep country, language, currency and settlement independent. Exact minor-unit money, explicit price books and five launch languages—including right-to-left Arabic—are part of the foundation, not an afterthought.
Home.securityTitle: The quiet checks behind every busy service.
Home.securityBody: Tenant isolation, least-privilege access, immutable payment amounts and durable event processing are built into the workflow. Google discovery never proves ownership, and a browser redirect never marks an order paid.
Home.closingBody: Start with your restaurant, your menu and your floor plan. PlatePilot keeps the system empty until your real data arrives.
Home.modesTitle: One system that does it all.
Home.modesBody: Ordering, payments, tables, kitchen and books in one place. Your team learns one system; your guests just order.
Home.modePickupBody: Serve more guests than your room can hold. Orders are priced and timed by the server, not the phone.
Home.modeDineBody: The classic room, plus QR ordering straight from the table when you want it.
Home.modeDeliveryBody: Zones, fees and minimums enforced server-side, so the menu you publish is the menu you honour.
Home.modeReserveBody: Book real tables from your floor plan. A table that is booked cannot be double-taken.
Home.tabsTitle: Features that carry a busy service.
Home.tabQrBody: Ease up your staff. Orders go from the guest's phone to your kitchen, priced by the server.
Home.tabQrP1: The table arrives with the scan — no table number typing
Home.tabQrP2: Prices come from your published menu, never the browser
Home.tabQrP3: A code from another restaurant shows nothing, by design
Home.tabOnlineTitle: Go digital and get live results
Home.tabOnlineBody: A storefront that reads like your restaurant: menu, hours, delivery zones and honest availability.
Home.tabOnlineP1: Scheduled orders only inside your opening hours
Home.tabOnlineP2: Exact minor-unit money in every currency you settle in
Home.tabOnlineP3: One status page per order, shared with the guest
Home.tabKitchenTitle: Get paid fast, cook in rhythm
Home.tabKitchenBody: Tickets route by station and preparation is tracked; the kitchen refuses what was never started.
Home.tabKitchenP1: One ticket per order, even when a provider retries
Home.tabKitchenP2: Stock leaves on service and lands in the day-end report
Home.tabKitchenP3: Split bills, bar tabs and part payments for real rooms
Home.integrationsTitle: Connected to the services you already run.
Home.integrationsBody: Hosted checkout with authentic signed webhooks, place discovery without an API key, and SMS alerts from your own gateway account. Nothing is faked: a payment is verified before it is shown as paid.
Home.faqOneA: Everything runs online in the browser. Set up your restaurant once and the storefront, kitchen, reports and settings read the same data. It runs on a hosted Postgres project or on its own embedded database, so it works without any external account.
Home.faqTwoA: On any device with a browser. The kitchen display shows live tickets routed by station, orders can be accepted at the counter, and every order carries a status page you can share with the guest.
Home.faqThreeQ: Which currencies and languages are supported?
Home.faqThreeA: Twelve currencies with exact minor-unit money, and five launch languages including right-to-left Arabic. Country, language and currency stay independent, so a franc-zone restaurant can run in French and settle in CFA.
Home.faqFourA: Hosted checkout through Stripe, Paystack or PayPal. Amounts are immutable once authorised, webhooks are signature-verified, and a payment is applied only after independent verification — a redirect alone never marks an order paid.
Home.heroRotateLabel: PlatePilot helps restaurants take orders, run the room and get paid.

Login.title: Welcome back to service.
Login.description: Use your work email to receive a secure sign-in link. Access is limited to your organization and assigned locations.
Login.sentBody: If the account is eligible, a sign-in link has been requested. Open it on this device to continue.
Login.notConfiguredBody: Add the public hosted-database project URL and anonymous key to enable secure staff sign-in. No account or session has been created.
Login.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one, and open it on this device.
Login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in emails have been requested in the last hour. Wait a little and try again.
Login.sendFailed: The sign-in email could not be sent. Check the address and try again.
Login.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.

Onboarding.title: Start with what’s real.
Onboarding.description: Connect a public listing for identification or enter everything yourself. Your operating details always come from you.
Onboarding.findBody: Search by name and city or address. Selecting a branch links its Place ID; it never grants ownership or access.
Onboarding.googleUnavailable: Google discovery is not configured. Manual setup is fully available.
Onboarding.searchUnavailable: Live search requires authentication, onboarding permission and a configured Google key.
Onboarding.noResults: No listings found. Check the branch address or continue manually.
Onboarding.googleAttribution: Search results provided by Google. Third-party attribution is shown when supplied.
Onboarding.manualBody: These details are merchant-supplied and remain separate from any public listing.
Onboarding.name: Restaurant name
Onboarding.menuBody: Upload a merchant-owned CSV. PlatePilot validates a preview before anything can be published. No prices, allergens, photos or availability are invented.
Onboarding.authRequired: Sign in to create a workspace or publish a menu. Your draft remains on this page.
Onboarding.configRequired: Persistence is not configured yet. You can inspect the setup flow, but no business has been created.
Onboarding.reviewBody: Ordering stays disabled until a real menu, service settings, payment eligibility and merchant review are complete.
Onboarding.error: The request could not be completed. No success was recorded.
Onboarding.signInTitle: Sign in to start setting up.
Onboarding.signInBody: PlatePilot needs to know who owns this restaurant before it can create a workspace. Use the email address your restaurant will use for service.
Onboarding.signInRequired: Sign in with your staff account before creating a workspace. A place listing is not proof of ownership.

Floor.title: Make the room yours.
Floor.description: Build an accessible plan from real measurements. This public planner keeps your draft in this browser; publishing requires an authorized restaurant workspace.
Floor.emptyBody: Enter the room dimensions, then add your first table. No stock layout or fictional tables are provided.
Floor.threeDBody: Optional static rendering. Your 2D controls remain available.
Floor.threeDError: 3D is unavailable on this device. Continue with the fully working 2D plan.
Floor.instructions: Select a table to edit it. Use arrow keys to move a selected table; hold Shift for larger steps.
Floor.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No tables yet} one {# table} other {# tables}}
Floor.publishUnavailable: Sign in and select an authorized location to publish. Your local draft is unchanged.
Floor.serviceEmpty: No live check is connected in this local planner. Publish to an authorized workspace to connect service.

Operations.title: The operating picture, without the noise.
Operations.description: Every module below reads real merchant data. Empty means empty; unavailable integrations say so. No decorative sales charts or fictional activity.
Operations.workspaceBody: Create or join an authorized restaurant workspace to open live orders, shifts, stock and reporting. Until then, this page is a capability guide—not a connected dashboard.
Operations.ordersBody: Server-priced pickup, delivery and dine-in orders with scoped guest tracking.
Operations.posBody: Walk-in checks, split tenders, discrepancies and end-of-day close.
Operations.reservationsBody: Transactional capacity, table assignment, deposits and no-show handling.
Operations.kitchenBody: Station routing, prep states, bump/recall and reconnect fallback.
Operations.inventoryBody: Versioned recipes, suppliers and an append-only stock movement ledger.
Operations.deliveryBody: Zones, scoped driver views, completion evidence and exceptions.
Operations.crmBody: Consent-led preferences, visits and reversible loyalty entries.
Operations.reportsBody: Currency-separated sales, refunds, tax, tips and close-of-day exports.
Operations.integrationsBody: Explicit connection status, safe tests, sync history and honest CSV fallbacks.

Reports.title: Day-end report
Reports.description: What the trading day looks like, read from the orders you actually took.
Reports.versusLastWeek: versus the same day last week
Reports.discountOrders: {count, plural, one {# order discounted} other {# orders discounted}}
Reports.notAvailable: The report is not available yet.
Reports.signInRequired: Sign in to see your trading day.
Reports.noLocation: No location is linked to your account yet.
Reports.largestDiscount: The largest single discount today was {amount}.

theft.title: Anti-theft report
theft.description: Refunds, discounts, voids and cash variances, next to each other per staff member. A flag is a question to ask, not an accusation.
theft.none: Nothing to report for this window.
theft.thresholdsNote: Flags: discounts above 20% of sales, voids or refunds above 5%, any cash variance.

taxExport.title: Tax export
taxExport.description: Every invoice issued in the window, as a CSV: number, date, net, tax and total in minor units.

Settings.title: How this location trades
Settings.description: Open the storefront, set the hours you serve, what delivery costs and which tables can be booked. Everything here is read by the ordering and reservation functions the moment you save.
Settings.signInRequired: Sign in to change how a location trades.
Settings.noLocation: You do not have a location yet. Finish onboarding first.

service.title: {location} — ordering
service.description: While ordering is on, the published menu on your storefront takes orders at the price you set.
service.closedHint: The storefront is closed: an order placed now is refused with ORDERING_NOT_ENABLED.
service.hoursHint: A day with no window is closed. Times are in the location timezone.
service.deliveryFeeHint: Added to a delivery order, in {currency}.
service.minimumOrderHint: A delivery order below this is refused.
service.taxHint: Applied to the subtotal and shown on the receipt.
service.prepMinutesHint: How long the kitchen needs before pickup.
service.postalCodesHint: Leave empty to deliver to the whole area.
service.smsPhoneHint: Where paid-order SMS alerts go, in international format.

zones.title: Delivery zones
zones.description: Charge different delivery fees by postal area. The longest matching prefix wins, so 8001 can cost less than the wider 80 region.
zones.name: Zone name
zones.prefixesHint: Comma separated. A customer's postal code is matched by prefix.
zones.empty: No zones yet. Without zones the flat delivery fee in service settings applies everywhere.

campaigns.title: Storefront campaigns
campaigns.description: Scheduled popups and banners on your storefront. A discount code shown here is enforced by the promotion's own limits at order time.
campaigns.headline: Headline

domains.title: Your own domain
domains.description: Serve your storefront from your own address. Point a CNAME at {target}, then verify — the check is a real DNS lookup.
domains.claimHint: You own it; we verify it.

google.title: Find your restaurant
google.description: Search Google for your restaurant and link the right branch. The link feeds structured data to search engines; it is not an ownership claim.
google.notConfigured: Google Places search is not configured on this deployment yet — add a Places API key to enable it.
google.paste: Or paste your Google Maps link
google.pastePlaceholder: https://www.google.com/maps/place/…  or a ChIJ… Place ID

venue.tablesDescription: A reservation is accepted against these. Sync from the floor planner to book what you have drawn.
venue.synced: Tables updated from the floor plan.
venue.name: Table name
venue.noTables: No tables yet. Add one here, or draw the room and sync it.
venue.customersDescription: Read from the orders this location took. Nothing is copied, so the list never disagrees with the till.

errors.ZONE_INCOMPLETE: Every zone needs a name and at least one postal prefix.
errors.DELIVERY_MIN_ORDER: The order is below this zone's minimum for delivery.

supply.title: Purchase orders
supply.description: Write down what you ordered from a supplier, then receive it. Stock only moves when the delivery arrives.
supply.noIngredients: Add an ingredient on the inventory screen before ordering.

stockCount.title: Stock count
stockCount.description: The ledger says what should be on the shelf. A count says what actually is, and the difference becomes one adjustment per ingredient.
stockCount.matched: Count completed — the shelf matches the ledger.
stockCount.none: No counts yet. Start one at close of trade.

menus.title: Menus by service period
menus.description: Publish additional menus for parts of the day. The storefront shows the menu that is serving right now, and falls back to the always-on menu.
menus.label: Menu name
menus.hint: The scheduled menu serves only inside its window on the listed days, in the location's own timezone.

loyalty.title: Loyalty & gift cards
loyalty.description: Guests earn points on money that actually arrives, and spend them as a discount at checkout. Gift cards are a tender: a card that covers the whole total pays for the order outright.
loyalty.earnHint: 1 means one point per minor unit of spend.
loyalty.redeemHint: 100 means 100 points buy one minor unit of discount.
loyalty.issued: Issued {code} — {value}. The code pays at checkout.

invoices.title: Invoice series
invoices.description: Invoice numbers run without gaps. An invoice is issued from a paid order, once; the tax export on the reports page is the accountant's view.
invoices.name: Series name

sms.title: SMS campaigns
sms.description: Text your guests who asked to hear from you. A phone joins the audience only when consent is recorded; sending is one message per person, once.
sms.noAudience: No one has opted in yet.

Pricing.title: Straight pricing, no games.
Pricing.lede: PlatePilot is self-hosted software. There is no monthly platform fee and no contract: you run it, you own your data, and your money goes to your payment provider, not to a middleman.
Pricing.includedBody: One download, every feature. There is no free tier to graduate from and nothing to unlock.
Pricing.inc1: Unlimited pickup, delivery and dine-in ordering
Pricing.inc2: Menu builder with photos, allergens and price books
Pricing.inc3: Floor planner, table QR and reservations
Pricing.inc5: Hosted checkout with Stripe, Paystack or PayPal
Pricing.costsBody: Running a restaurant already costs money. PlatePilot adds none of its own.
Pricing.cost1Body: A small server or a database free tier gets you started. Scale when the orders say so.
Pricing.cost2Body: Your provider's standard rate on your own account. Funds settle to you directly.
Pricing.cost3Body: Optional, and usually a few dollars a year. Point it and publish.
Pricing.cmp2a: In their cloud, on their terms
Pricing.cmp2b: In your database, exportable any time
Pricing.cmp3: Your brand on the ordering site
Pricing.cmp4b: None. It runs where you point it
Pricing.cmp5b: Five at launch, including right-to-left Arabic
Pricing.ctaBody: Set it up in an afternoon. The system stays empty until your real data arrives.

FeaturesPage.title: Everything a service needs. Nothing it doesn't.
FeaturesPage.lede: One system carries the whole day: the menu your guests order from, the room your team reads, the kitchen that cooks it, and the money trail behind all of it.
FeaturesPage.boxBody: No add-on market, no feature gates. These ship with the product.
FeaturesPage.ctaTitle: See it with your own menu.
FeaturesPage.ctaBody: Setup is a wizard, not a project. Your first storefront can be live today.

HowItWorks.title: A seamless journey, from empty system to first order.
HowItWorks.lede: Six steps to set up, five taps for a guest to order. Every hand-off stays connected to the same order.
HowItWorks.setupTitle: One setup that does it all
HowItWorks.setupBody: Everything is configured once, in one place, and every surface reads the same data.
HowItWorks.step1Body: Sign in with one email. No credit card, no trial clock.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Name, address, currency and language. The wizard walks you through it.
HowItWorks.step3Body: Dishes, prices, photos and allergens. Type it or upload a CSV.
HowItWorks.step4Body: Opening hours, delivery zones and fees, table capacity, taxes.
HowItWorks.step5Body: Your ordering site goes live on your domain, in five languages.
HowItWorks.step6Body: Pickup, delivery and table QR all land in the same kitchen.
HowItWorks.guestBody: No app to install, no account to create. The order just flows.
HowItWorks.guest2: Adds dishes from your live menu
HowItWorks.guest4: Tracks the order on its status page
HowItWorks.flowTitle: How orders move in and out
HowItWorks.flowBody: Nothing in this chain is manual or ambiguous. The same order object travels end to end.
HowItWorks.flow1: In: the order arrives from the web, a QR session or the counter
HowItWorks.flow2: Priced by the server: rules, zones and taxes applied server-side
HowItWorks.flow3: Out: a ticket reaches the kitchen screen, routed by station
HowItWorks.flow4: In: the payment provider confirms by signed webhook
HowItWorks.flow5: Verified: the payment is applied only after independent checks
HowItWorks.flow6: Out: the guest's status page updates, and the day-end report collects it
HowItWorks.ctaBody: The first step takes a minute. The rest follows your menu.

IntegrationsPage.title: Connected to the services you already run.
IntegrationsPage.lede: PlatePilot integrates where money and messages move, and stays honest about every connection: a payment is verified before it is shown as paid.
IntegrationsPage.catPayBody: Hosted checkout on your own merchant accounts. Signed webhooks are verified, amounts are immutable once authorised, and nothing marks an order paid on a redirect alone.
IntegrationsPage.catDiscoveryBody: Find your restaurant without typing an address, and prove the place is yours without handing over an API key to the page that shows it.
IntegrationsPage.catMessagesBody: Reach your guests through your own accounts: order and booking confirmations by email, campaigns by SMS through your gateway credentials.
IntegrationsPage.catDataBody: Run on a hosted Postgres you control or on the embedded database that ships with the app. Same schema, same behaviour, no vendor lock-in.
IntegrationsPage.catBrandBody: Publish under your own domain with your own identity. Nothing on the guest's screen says PlatePilot.
IntegrationsPage.docsNote: Machine-readable documentation ships with every install, so search engines and assistants can read your menus directly.
IntegrationsPage.ctaBody: Keys live in your settings, on your server. No third party holds them.

WhiteLabelPage.title: Your brand, end to end.
WhiteLabelPage.lede: The ordering site, the menus, the emails and the domain all wear your restaurant's name. The platform stays invisible to your guests.
WhiteLabelPage.point1Body: Add your own domain in settings, verify it, and your storefront publishes there. Certificates handled by your hosting.
WhiteLabelPage.point2Body: Your name, address and photos on every page the guest sees. Orders come from your restaurant, not from a marketplace.
WhiteLabelPage.point3Body: Any browser device works: a laptop at the counter, a tablet in the kitchen, a phone in your pocket. No locked-in terminals.
WhiteLabelPage.point4Body: Five launch languages including right-to-left Arabic, per guest. One restaurant, five audiences.
WhiteLabelPage.ctaBody: Custom domains are part of the standard setup, not a premium tier.

AboutPage.title: A restaurant operating system, built in the open.
AboutPage.lede: PlatePilot exists because restaurants deserve software they can own: no platform fee between them and their guests, no lock-in, no mystery about where the data lives.
AboutPage.whatBody: A complete restaurant platform: ordering for pickup, delivery and dine-in, table QR, reservations, a floor planner in 2D and 3D, a kitchen display, hosted payments with verified webhooks, and the reports that close the day. Self-hosted or on your own hosted database.
AboutPage.belief1: Empty means empty: the system shows your data or nothing at all.
AboutPage.belief2: A payment is paid when it is verified, not when a browser redirects.
AboutPage.belief3: Accessibility is part of the product: the floor stays usable in 2D, with a keyboard.
AboutPage.belief4: Your guests belong to you, in your database, in your language.
AboutPage.contactBody: Questions, hosting help or a walkthrough of the security model: write to the project team and you will hear back from the people who build it.

Start.metaDescription: Open a page for your restaurant, publish your menu and take orders. 200 orders a month free, 0% commission.
Start.title: Open your shop. Keep your name.
Start.lede: Your page, your prices, your staff. Our server prices every order, so the basket a guest sends is never the basket they are charged for.
